process_evidence.i_t_assibilation: Green & Morrison (2018) gives kari+t+aa -> karisaa and describes t-assibilation after i; Puglielli & Cabdallah Cumar Mansuur (1997) independently gives kari+t+ay and joogi+t+ay with t -> s after i; Ahmed Mohamed (2013) independently prints kari 2pl karisaan.
process_evidence.i_vowel_glide: Ahmed Mohamed (2013) explicitly prints kariyaa and kariyaan; Green & Jones (2016), table 24, independently prints the same Northern/Benaadir weak-causative present surfaces.
process_evidence.i_n_weak_causative_manner_alternation: Green & Jones (2016), table 24, independently prints Northern/Benaadir weak-causative 1pl karinnaa. Stage 1L deliberately does not cite Green 2021 or the frozen v11 target surface as activation evidence.

benchmark_isolation.note: The eligible class lexicon was merged before v11 answers existed. v11 answer rows are never read by this activation rule. Stage 1L uses a separate process-evidence map that excludes Green 2021/v11 target surfaces and applies uniformly to the complete pre-v11 reviewed C2A class-only inventory.

evidence.class_authorization: Zorc 2019 Somali-English Dictionary class-only registry, frozen on main before v11; each eligible lemma is explicitly labelled v2a.
evidence.present_person_morphology: Existing reviewed MORPH-CONJ-IIA-MPH-001 person/TAM structure, developed before v11. Stage 1L process authorization is limited to the independent evidence map above rather than the frozen v11 answer source.
evidence.activation_rationale: v11 was frozen and measured at zero after the class registry existed but before class-level generation. Activating the already-reviewed class morphology uniformly across that preauthorized registry tests cross-lemma generalization rather than target memorization.

notes: Finite class-authorized present generation only. The activation does not change the historical generation_enabled=false flag in the class lexicon, does not create target-specific profiles, does not infer new class membership, does not generate past forms, and grants no correction authority.
